title: Coagulable
summary: COAGULABLE, adjective [See Coagulate.] That may be concreted; capable of congealing or changing from a liquid to an inspissated state; as coagulable lymph.

inlines.v: COAGULABLE, adjective [See Coagulate.] That may be concreted; capable of congealing or changing from a liquid to an inspissated state; as coagulable lymph.
